You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"something weird is happening with my <USER> mobile app. every time I switch playlists, my music randomly pauses itself 1min 46sec into the first song. what does this even mean?"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! That sounds frustrating! Can you share what device, operating system, and Spotify version you're using? We'll help you sort this out! 

Keep us posted! /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Remove '/AI' and add a suggestion to try reinstalling the app for clarity."}
